The SNC-Lavalin affair established the template: political pressure on independent officers, documented by ethics investigations, with no criminal consequences. The pattern repeats: RCMP Commissioner Lucki pressured investigators on Nova Scotia firearms data (confirmed by MCC sworn testimony).
